extracted.intended_audience: NIH staff, research administrators, and the extramural scientific research community
extracted.subtask_short: NIH grant reporting and analysis office
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Office of Research Reporting and Analysis (ORRA): its mission, major responsibilities, organizational divisions, and key products/services supporting NIH grant lifecycle reporting, data analysis, and funding opportunity publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: data and reporting support for grants processing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides data and reporting support for grants processing for NIH and other agencies (HHS Operating Divisions and the Veterans’ Administration) and works with the user community to provide efficient techniques for the conduct of extramural business. This effort is intended to guide the management of the NIH research portfolio and improve the nation's health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide reporting technologies for full grant administration life cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides reporting technologies for the full life cycle of grant administration functions for the NIH and other agencies that use the eRA systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supply data and reports to analyze and manage investment
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides data and reports that are required to analyze and manage NIH and other agencies’ investment in the grant recipient community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy implementation for development/publication of funding opportunities and Notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides policy implementation strategies, guidance, systems, and resources for the development and publication of funding opportunities and Notices that inform the public and scientific research community of NIH’s scientific priorities, programs, and policies for grants and contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key products and services supporting grants and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Key Products and Services: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts; NIH Data Book; NIH RePORT; NIH Categorical Spending; OERStats; NIH Research Condition and Disease Categorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These products are the principal outputs ORRA references for reporting, publication of funding information, spending categorization, and public data access used by NIH, other agencies, and the research community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational structure for reporting and analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: ORRA Management and Offices/Divisions include the Division of Scientific Categorization and Analysis (DSCA) and the Division of Statistical Analysis and Reporting (DSAR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational divisions indicate functional areas responsible for scientific categorization/analysis and statistical analysis/reporting; useful for understanding points-of-contact and responsibilities for specific reporting tasks.
